title: Circuit breaker with half-open single-probe recovery
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (expanded clean stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer may flag the state machine as needless complexity or the probe flag as a race. The lock guards every state transition, the wrapped call itself runs outside the lock (so a slow call does not block state reads), half-open admits exactly one probe because _probe_in_flight is claimed under the lock before the probe runs, a failed probe re-opens the breaker with a fresh timestamp, timing uses a monotonic clock so wall-clock jumps cannot extend or shorten the cooldown, and non-Exception signals release the probe slot without being counted as failures.

label_amendments.finding_title: Stale success unconditionally re-closes a circuit opened by another thread
